text:
mike_oncall: Follow-up from postmortem: recurring pages from auth-proxy (403/401 bursts). Need owners + quick plan for dedupe, thresholds, suppression, canary, and monthly churn audit. Short tracker: https://go/rems/auth-churn.

lina_sre: I'll own threshold tuning and the monthly audit. Plan: bump client-scoped threshold by 15% then monitor 7d; add global p99 spike alert to avoid masking real issues.

owen_dev: I'll add dedupe key util: key = client_id:path:hash(body,8). Will include route and first 32 bytes in hash. Add unit tests and staging deploy. ETA 3 days.

notify-bot: Incident 2026-06-04: auth-proxy auth spike -> 33 pages, peak 05:10 UTC.

tara_prod: Recommend suppression window 180s per key, plus a canary that simulates retry-loop traffic at 5% traffic for 48h. I'll coordinate client outreach for top offenders.

mike_oncall: Proposed alert (staging):
```
alert: AuthProxyAuthBurst
expr: sum(rate(auth_responses_total{status=~"4.."}[5m])) by (client_id, path) > 30
for: 2m
```
Paging dedupe config: key: "{{client_id}}:{{path}}:{{hash(body,8)}}" suppression_window: 3m

lina_sre: Sounds good. Can we gate rollout with the synthetic so we can validate suppression doesn't suppress real regressions? I'll add dashboard panels to show unique dedupe keys over time.

mike_oncall: Owners & ETAs: owen (dedupe util + PR) 3d, lina (thresholds + audit dashboards) 10d, tara (canary + client coord) 7d. Sync Friday 09:30 UTC to review PRs and metrics. If canary reduces pages by >60% in 48h we close short-term action items.
